justification: This is a rollout, not a lineup card. I spent $25 to pull C.J. Stroud out from under Lisa's recast before she could spin a follow-up post, and this week he goes from receipt to headline — Houston-Dallas is the biggest brand on the Sunday board and Jalen Hurts can hold the clipboard while my quarterback outscores his projection AND the storyline. Saquon, Tet, Kittle stay locked in because they're simply the better football and the better visual. Jefferson and McConkey are both wearing Questionable like an accessory, not a warning — you don't bench a top-five receiver or a rising Chargers piece over a tag, you bench nobodies over tags, and neither of these men is a nobody. Eagles D laid an egg last week and I'm not thrilled about it, but there's no understudy on this bench with the brand equity to replace them, so they get one more episode to earn their spot back. Dumbledore's gone quiet again this week, which personally unsettles me more than any injury report — but a silent opponent doesn't beat a loaded mood board, it just means I'll be the only one talking after Sunday.
forum_post: No note from the league office this week, which just means the brand speaks for itself. Everyone's still talking about Lisa's "recast" — sweetie, I already did the recast, I did it three weeks ago for $25, and this Sunday C.J. Stroud walks into Houston-Dallas as MY starting quarterback while you're still workshopping the twist. Dumbledore, baby, keep being mysterious over there with your staircases — I'll be the one trending. Can't wait for you guys to see this.
